title: South Korea's data protection commission and ministries present plan to move public-agency scraping to API-based transmission from 2027
summary: Daily Security reports that Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission and related ministries presented a plan on 26 November to move from scraping to API-based and other safe personal-data transmission in stages from 2027. The article says 754 businesses were found using scraping on 129 public agency websites, totaling 3,164 cases. The stated aim is to reduce leak and misuse risk.
plain: Korean authorities plan to replace scraping of public agency websites with safer API-based transmission in stages from 2027, to reduce the risk of personal data leaks and misuse.
exec: Firms that collect data from Korean public agency sites by scraping will have to move to API-based transmission, per the plan reported.

sources.name: Daily Security (Korea): 정부, 개인정보 유출 위험 높은 ‘스크래핑’ 개선 나선다…2027년부터 API 기반 안전한 전송체계 전환

evidence.quote: 754개 사업자가 129개 공공기관 홈페이지를 대상으로 총 3,164건의 스크래핑을 활용하고 있는 것으로 파악됐다.

validation.note: Only Daily Security's article was read; the commission's press release was not found.
